notes.title: Update time!
notes.content:
Hey you guys!

Just wanted to say thank you to everyone who bought the game and I wanted to let you know about my post-launch plans.

Firstly, I will work on adding achievements to the game. Not gonna go too crazy on this, just some simple achieves for finishing the game with different romance options.
Secondly, there is a DLC on the way.

Thanks again,
-BC
